title: AHLEM Presents “ECHOES OF LOVE” Eyewear Collection
summary:
Summary

AHLEM unveils its 17-frame "ECHOES OF LOVE" collection inspired by romantic narratives.The range features hand-hammered metals, 22K gold electroplating, nickel-free bronze.Available now via the brand's website and flagship stores.

Los Angeles-based luxury eyewear label AHLEM, founded by Paris-born designer Ahlem Manai-Platt, has unveiled its newest seasonal collection, titled "ECHOES OF LOVE." Comprising 17 distinct metal and acetate frames, the range draws creative inspiration from a cinematic love story set across a single day in a Paris apartment, capturing the emotional nuances between intimacy, tension, and humor.Constructed through rigorous reductionism to highlight proportion and restraint, the line features plant-based cotton flower acetate frames alongside palladium-electroplated metal options finished with 22K gold coating. A key technical highlight includes the introduction of custom nickel-free bronze temples - developed over a year for exceptional skin feel, structural memory, and lightweight durability - paired with hand-hammered textures, step-like temple reliefs and laser-engraved geometric circle and triangle motifs on the hinges and pins.Handcrafted by master artisans in historic eyewear workshops across France, the collection translates architectural references - ranging from Milanese staircases to geometric shadows found in Kyoto - into functional luxury. The acetate range balances deep jewel tones with translucent neutrals that react dynamically to ambient light, while the structural metal pieces combine cool structural stability with warm gold surfaces.AHLEM’s "ECHOES OF LOVE" collection is currently available globally via the brand's physical flagships as well as its official webstore.

title: SAN SAN GEAR Expands Retail Presence With New Flagship Location in Seoul’s Hannam Neighborhood
summary:
Summary

SAN SAN GEAR opens its second flagship store in Hannam-dong, Seoul.Designed by Tokyo’s DAIKEI MILLS around "Duality," converting a private residence into public retail space.Highlights include sculptural furniture, a film screening space, and multi-level brand storytelling.

SAN SAN GEAR has officially opened its second flagship store in the quiet, upscale neighborhood of Hannam-dong in Seoul, following its initial flagship in Hapjeong. Designed in collaboration with Tokyo-based studio DAIKEI MILLS, the space embodies the theme of “Duality,” exploring the coexistence of contrasting values such as street style and utility, functionality and design, and private versus public space.Architectural elements blur boundaries between house and courtyard, while layered spatial experiences across multiple floors create a dynamic environment. Highlights include a large circular structure on the first floor, runway-like platforms on the second, and a basement screening room showcasing The Other Lights in the City, a short film tied to the brand’s Fall/Winter 2026 “CABLE” collection.The flagship integrates contributions from international and local designers, with sculptural furniture by Tokyo’s SIIN SIIN and refined pieces by Seoul-based Seong-il Choi, enhancing the immersive brand narrative. Preserving textures of the original residence while introducing public-space motifs, the store reflects SAN SAN GEAR’s expanded worldview and evolving identity. Officially open now, the Hannam flagship establishes a new cultural destination where visitors can engage deeply with the brand’s philosophy and aesthetic.SAN SAN GEAR Hannam Flagship37-10, Itaewon-ro 55-gil, Yongsan-gu,Seoul, South Korea

title: Freddie Mercury's Most Iconic Stage Costumes Are Coming to London's V&A Museum
summary:
Summary

Features eight iconic costumes and personal accessories tracing the legendary frontman's career from Queen's 1973 debut to his later solo workDeveloped in collaboration with Mary Austin to celebrate what would have been Mercury's 80th anniversary yearIncludes a free trail across six locations within the museum's South Kensington galleries featuring sets designed by Tom Piper

The Victoria & Albert Museum is celebrating the enduring cultural legacy of Queen's legendary frontman with Freddie Mercury | Splendid Things. Opening on October 24, 2026, the free trail will map the performer's meteoric rise to global stardom and his subsequent solo career through his highly theatrical wardrobe. The exhibition scatters Mercury's garments across the institution's permanent galleries to explore the meticulous visual language behind one of music history's most recognizable public personas.Developed in collaboration with Mary Austin, Mercury's former fiancée and confidante of two decades, the display borrows seven looks directly from her private collection. The exhibition title itself pulls from the singer's own 1978 declaration: "I like to be surrounded by splendid things. I want to lead a Victorian life surrounded by exquisite clutter." This affinity for curated grandiosity translates directly into the six-stop trail, which creates dialogue between the rocker's stage wear and the museum's existing holdings in fashion, decorative arts and performance.Standout pieces highlight pivotal eras in the band's discography. Visitors can view a 1970s monochrome ensemble worn for an early gig at Imperial College that later graced the cover of Queen's 1973 debut album. The retrospective also features the "Mercury Wing" catsuit designed by Wendy de Smet for the 1975-76 A Night at the Opera tour and the groundbreaking "Bohemian Rhapsody" video. Moving into his stadium era, the display showcases the regal signature crown and cloak crafted by Diana Moseley for his final 1986 Magic Tour appearance at Knebworth alongside quieter personal wardrobe items and his suit from the "Made in Heaven" music video.Award-winning theater and exhibition designer Tom Piper transformed the museum spaces to capture the frontman's magnetic energy. Known for his work with the Royal Shakespeare Company, Piper integrates set dressing, sound and lighting to frame each era. Specially crafted mannequins strike dynamic poses to emulate Mercury's unmatched stage presence, reinforcing how his clothing served as essential tools to command vast arena crowds and cement his status as a permanent pop culture fixture. The installation runs through January 17, 2027.

title: 「カカン」工藤花観がニットとテーラリングで紡ぐ、自分の生き方を表現するお守りとしての服
summary: 日々ファッションを中心にさまざまな領域の新世代を取材するFASHIONSNAPが、次代を担うアップカミングな才能にフォーカスする「次世代クリエイター」特集。設立5年以下で独自の世界観を持つ、注目の若手デザイナー2人目としてフィーチャーするのは、2024年に自身のブランド「カカン（KAKAN）」を立ち上げた工藤花観だ。 　ロンドンのセントラル・セント・マーチンズでファインアートとアクセサリーを専攻し、ミラノでファッションデザインを学んだ彼女が手掛ける服には、相反する要素が美しく共存している。シグネチャーである手紡ぎ糸の「HANDSPAN」シリーズに代表される、有機的で野生的な揺らぎを内包したアートピースのようなニット。その一方で、日常の身体に心地よく寄り添うテーラリングアイテムも支持を集めている。 　「TOKYO FASHION AWARD 2026」の受賞や、東京ファッションウィークでの初ランウェイ、バレエ公演「POLA presents BALLET TheNewClassic 2026」の衣装制作など、デビュー3年目ながら着実に歩みを進めるカカン。9月頭に予定されていた2027年春夏シーズンのランウェイショーは、先日、工藤の体調不良で惜しくも中止と発表されたが、引き続きブランドへの期待は高い。「服は『羊水』のように自分を守ってくれる存在」であると同時に、「自分の生き方をアティチュードとして表現するのに一番使いやすいもの」だと語る工藤は今、自身とブランドの現在地をどう見つめているのか。ロンドンやミラノで得た学びから、人の感覚や感情に寄り添い訴えかけるものづくりの背景、彼女が描くブランドの未来像までを紐解く。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: GEEKS RULE and ‘Ghost in the Shell’ Reunite for a London Pop-Up Built Around Two Silkscreen T-Shirts
summary:
Summary

GEEKS RULE is staging a limited-time Ghost in the Shell pop-up at Dover Street Market LondonThe lineup centers on two silkscreen tees, one tied to the new anime series and one to the 1995 filmPopular archive pieces previously sold in Japan return as part of the collection

GEEKS RULE is bringing its Ghost in the Shell collaboration to Dover Street Market London with a limited-time pop-up that gathers the label's takes on the franchise in one place. Anchored by two silkscreen-printed T-shirts, the shop draws on both the property's newest anime chapter and its most iconic screen moment, giving the collection a foot in each era.The two tees split their references cleanly. One draws on the new Ghost in the Shell anime series and comes in the widest range, offered in White, Black, and Yellow. The other looks back to the 1995 film Ghost in the Shell, arriving in a single Black colorway that leans into the darker, more cinematic side of the source material. Both shirts use silkscreen printing and run from M through XXL, keeping the sizing consistent across the pair.That split is what gives the drop its pull. Ghost in the Shell has spent three decades as a touchstone for cyberpunk aesthetics, its influence stretching across film, animation, and fashion well beyond its original audience. By putting a contemporary anime design next to a tribute to the 1995 feature, GEEKS RULE lets longtime fans and newer viewers meet the franchise wherever they entered it.The pop-up reaches past the two headline tees. Alongside the new pieces, GEEKS RULE is reissuing archive items from its earlier Japan run, a set that built a following the first time around and now gets a second life for the London audience. That mix of fresh designs and returning favorites frames the shop as a fuller survey of the collaboration rather than a single-item release.The GEEKS RULE Ghost in the Shell drops at Dover Street Market London and the online shop on August 28.

summary:
Summary

title: The New Student-Focused NYC by CUNY Collection is Built for the Real Heartbeat of the City
summary:
The City University of New York is quietly staging a cultural takeover beyond the confines of a traditional lecture hall. With a massive footprint of 247,000 students spanning 26 colleges across the five boroughs, CUNY has always been the literal heartbeat of New York City. Now, the university is leaning heavily into that foundational identity with “NYC by CUNY” Spring ’26 collection, an exclusive streetwear range that evolves the campus bookstore merchandise to reflect authentic New York subculture. With this collection, CUNY is embedding itself into the local fashion ecosystem, proving that higher education can actively speak the visual language of the streets it calls home.At its core, this drop is rooted in localized storytelling and everyday New York nostalgia. The standout is a dark graphic tee featuring a meticulously detailed NYC bodega facade, complete with a legendary bodega cat and all 26 college names hidden inside the store signs. For those who grew up on early-2000s East Coast hip-hop, a charcoal metallic tee pays direct homage to the iconic, iridescent rap styling of Queensbridge legend Nas. The rest of the capsule balances this raw energy with premium academic staples, including a heavily washed denim tote bag engineered for students on the move, an NYC souvenir-inspired cream ringer tee, and contrasting crewnecks. There’s one in an ultra-clean forest camo and another in a classic red plaid that bridges the gap between ivy league prestige and concrete streetwear.What makes this project culturally resonant is in the authenticity of its execution. CUNY handed the keys of the entire production over to its own community. The capsule was designed by Baruch College alumni Milton Gordon and Vera Rilossi (who also graduated from BMCC), captured through the lens of Hunter College alum Stanley Ligon, and modeled entirely by actual, current students. Even the editorial lookbook locations were selected with deep cultural intent: the crewnecks were shot amidst the historic architectural woodwork of Baruch’s Oak Room to respect academic tradition, while other pieces were photographed on campus at Lehman College to pay respect to the Bronx—a place that birthed hip-hop music and helped introduced streetwear culture.Ultimately, “NYC by CUNY” matters because it validates the identity of the real New York. It’s a love letter to a student body where half of the undergraduates come from households earning under $30,000 USD a year, and 71% are the first in their families to ever attend college.CUNY represents the ultimate beacon of social mobility, where 82% of freshmen are products of the city’s public school system, and another 82% stick around after graduation to build the future of the five boroughs. By trading stuffy academic pretension for genuine cultural currency, CUNY is executing a beautiful mission of giving hardworking, first-generation New Yorkers the elevated, culturally rich representation they’ve earned.To purchase pieces from the collection visit cuny.edu/collegiate.

title: Gucci's Primavera Campaign Is a Fusion of K-Pop, UK Underground, DMV Rap & More
summary:
SummaryThe Gucci FW26 Primavera campaign stars Jin, Shawn Mendes, EsDeeKid, NINGNING, Rico Nasty, Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, and Alex Consani.Shot by Michal Chelbin, it highlights everyday glamour featuring leather and fur-forward menswear and womenswear.In Milan last Spring, Demna's FW26 runway debut set a new tone for Gucci, rooted in pop culture and an equal embrace of the high and low. The Creative Director's democratic ethos continues yet again in the star-studded Gucci Primavera campaign, which traverses the realms of cinema, global pop, emerging acts, and sports culture.Photographed by Michal Chelbin, the campaign's setting departs from the clean backdrops of Demna's typical style for a rustic Italian interior true to Gucci's Florentine heritage. The cast enlists 10 major international figures, each with varying degrees of fame. Notably in music, BTS's Jin, American singer Shawn Mendes, UK underground star EsDeeKid, Chinese singer NINGNING, and DMV rapper Rico Nasty showcase the diverse musical taste profile Demna has shown throughout his career. In a nod to American football, legendary athlete Tom Brady makes an unexpected appearance, while Chinese actor Xiao Zhan and South Korean actress Lee Young Ae represent Asian cinema.In this campaign, the FW26 collection is seen in a new, softer light, offering a better impression of its everyday, albeit glamorous sensibility. In menswear, leather and lustrous fabrics reign supreme. Standout pieces include the leather motorsport jacket worn by Jin, Shawn Mendes's shiny muscle t-shirt, and the golden trousers worn by Xiao Zhan. Womenswear leans more heavily into furs, as seen in a cream fur coat styled on Rico Nasty with a leather handbag, and on a fur shoulder wrap worn by Lee Young Ae. American model and internet personality Alex Consani's look reads as the centerpiece of the campaign, featuring an asymmetrical, purple sequined dress with a pearl-studded clutch.See the full campaign in the gallery above and stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights.

title: Stockholm Surfboard Club and RHC Turn the Icon Tag Navy for the "Black Beach" Capsule
summary:
Summary

Stockholm Surfboard Club and RHC assemble a special-order "Black Beach" capsule described as one of SSC's largest-ever rangesThree of the brand's signature logos are applied selectively across a hooded shirt, polo shirt, back logo tee, and capSSC's signature red icon tag is reworked in navy for the first time as a world-first special-order label

Stockholm Surfboard Club and RHC have teamed on "Black Beach," a special-order capsule that pairs the Swedish label's surf sensibility with Ron Herman's clean house style. Built out as one of SSC's largest assortments to date, the collection spans four core pieces and centers on a detail the brand has never altered before: its signature icon tag, here rendered in navy.The logos do the design work. The capsule is built around three of the signature logos SSC has carried and preserved over the years, applied piece by piece so that each garment gets the mark best suited to its character rather than a single logo stamped across the range. That approach runs through all four styles, from the cap and back logo tee to the polo shirt and hooded shirt, the latter two representing the kind of pieces that have become popular signatures of SSC in recent seasons.The headline detail is smaller but more significant. For "Black Beach," SSC took its emblematic red-based icon tag and switched it to a navy base, creating what the collection frames as a world-first special-order label for the brand. It is a subtle change on paper, but for a label whose red tag functions as a recognition point, reworking it in navy turns an ordinary branding element into the capsule's defining flourish, finished with close attention to detail.The lineup itself is compact but considered. It runs across a black Hooded Shirt, a black Polo Shirt, a white Back Logo Tee, and a black Logo Cap, a mostly blacked-out spread that reads directly off the "Black Beach" name. Taken together, the release positions itself as a meeting of Stockholm's quiet surf culture and RHC's understated sensibility, framed as a one-season-only capsule rather than a permanent addition.The Stockholm Surfboard Club x RHC "Black Beach" collection arrives at the online store on August 29 and is already available at RHC Ron Herman and Ron Herman "R" stores.

title: 「無知って強い」　20代で店を始めた3人が語る、令和のセレクトショップ事情
summary: 次のファッションシーンを作るのは、デザイナーだけではない。どんな服を選び、どう見せるか。独自の感性で新たなスタイルを提案するショップもまた、新しい才能や価値観が広がっていくきっかけを作る存在だ。 　そこでFASHIONSNAPの「次世代クリエイター」特集の2本目では、20代でそれぞれショップを立ち上げた「スタジオラボ404ドットコム（studiolab404.com）」（以下、スタジオラボ）のモネと、「ディソナンス（DISSONANCE）」の森下リョウジ、モハメド・アズハリ・アフメド（Mohamed Azhari Ahmed）の鼎談を実施。スタジオラボは、デッドストックと国内外のデザイナーズブランド、オリジナルアイテムを独自の視点で提案。一方のディソナンスは、国内外のデザイナーズブランドのアーカイヴを軸に、オリジナルレーベルの販売やヴィジュアル制作、「エイチ ビューティー＆ユース（H BEAUTY&YOUTH）」の古着コーナー「H_VINTAGE」のキュレーションなどを手掛けている。異なるアプローチで店を作る彼らは、今のファッションをどう見て、何を面白いと感じているのか。20代で店を始めた理由から、セレクトの基準、同世代への意識、そしてこれから作りたい景色まで、同世代だからこその率直な会話を記録した。 モネ （MONET） 「スタジオラボ404ドットコム」オーナー兼ディレクター 1994年、兵庫県生まれ。ニューヨークでSNS運用やマーケティング、ショールーム業務などを経験後、 2021年に東京・祐天寺でセレクトショップ「スタジオラボ404ドットコム」を創業。デッドストックアイテムや国内未上陸ブランド、ジュエリーなどを扱いながら、コミュニティとしての店づくりにも取り組む。2026年4月に大阪・心斎橋パルコに新店舗をオープンした 。 森下凌司 DISSONANCEオーナー、スタイリスト 1996年、広島県生まれ。学生時代に古着屋で2年間勤務。大学卒業後はアパレル企業に入社し、販売員を2年間経験した後、2022年に「ディソナンス」をオープン。現在はバイイングやショップ運営のほか、ファッションスタイリストとしても活動中。 モハメド・アズハリ・アフメド DISSONANCEオーナー 1998年、東京都生まれ。モデル、フォトグラファー、WEBディレクターとしてファッション業界を中心に活動する一方、中目黒のヴィンテージショップ「ディソナンス」も運営。 ◾️studiolab404.com2021年に東京・祐天寺にオープン。上海発「ルオハン（RUOHAN）」や米国発「ノン ラック（NONG RAK）」などのデザイナーズブランドやヴィンテージ、オリジナルプロダクトを独自の視点で提案している。2026年4月に心斎橋パルコに2号店を出店した。【祐天寺店】住所：東京都目黒区祐天寺1-31-12営業時間：13:00〜20:00定休日：水・木曜【心斎橋店】住所：大阪府大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-8-3 心斎橋パルコ 地下1階営業時間：10:00〜20:00公式サイトInstagram ◾️DISSONANCE2022年に東京・渋谷に予約制ショップとしてオープン。2024年10月に中目黒へ移転し、予約不要の通常営業を開始した。ヴィンテージやデザイナーズのアーカイヴ、オリジナルブランド「ニュートラル（Ntrul）」などを販売するほか、衣装のリース業務も行う。2026年4月からは「エイチ ビューティー＆ユース（H BEAUTY&YOUTH）」の古着コーナー「H_VINTAGE」のキュレーションを担当している。住所：東京都目黒区上目黒1-15-1営業時間：14:00〜20:00公式サイトInstagram このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: Louis Vuitton Steers Its Trunk-Making Heritage Under the Sea With the High Trunks
summary:
Summary

Louis Vuitton frames its new High Trunks as an oceanic evolution of the Courrier Lozine 110Pharrell Williams anchors the project in the House's trunk-making history and the flexibility written into the 1905 Monogram patentTechniques ranging from hand-cut leather to inlaid mother of pearl and mirrored chrome push the Monogram into new material territory

Louis Vuitton has unveiled the High Trunks, a set of oceanic reinterpretations of the Courrier Lozine 110 introduced by Men's Creative Director Pharrell Williams for the House's Men's Spring-Summer 2027 collection. Rather than treat the trunk as a fixed object, the project uses it as a testing ground for craft, translating the marine theme at the center of the season into surfaces built from leather, shell, and chrome.The heritage argument sits right in the release. Louis Vuitton points to its 1905 Monogram patent, which explicitly allowed for variations in color, size, and material, and positions that document as the license for everything the High Trunks attempt. It is a neat way of framing radical material experiments as an extension of the House's own rulebook rather than a break from it, tying Pharrell's oceanic vision back to a founding principle instead of layering it on top. Louis Vuitton has long invited outside artists and designers into its world, and Pharrell's tenure as Men's Creative Director continues that pattern of handing the Monogram to a new author.Each trunk carries the theme through a different discipline. The unique Leather Marquetry "Under the Sea" Courrier Lozine 110 renders coral reefs, tropical fish, and aquatic flora from more than 1,500 individually cut leather elements, drawing on over 35 leathers chosen for grain, color, and texture, with shell-shaped metallic corners carrying the marine motif past the marquetry itself. The Mother of Pearl Marquetry version, made alongside a French marquetry artisan, inlays more than 2,000 hand-cut pieces of sustainably sourced mother of pearl into smoked larch wood, letting the Monogram catch and shift the light. The Chrome Wave takes the opposite route, sculpting transparent acrylic into wave forms, laser-engraving the Monogram, then finishing the panels in motion with two silver chrome coatings for a mirrored surface hiding neon Monogram flowers, its contemporary shell opening onto a traditional cream VVN leather interior.The collection stretches well beyond those three. Liquid Python wraps both the Courrier Lozine 110 and the Coffret 8 Montres in hand-finished python leather with a water-like effect, while the Summer Captions Courrier Lozine 110 catches a seaside-sunset glow through translucent acrylic. New silhouettes such as the LV Turtle Trunk and Neo Briefcase Trunk revisit the House's travel vocabulary in contemporary proportions, and the Mini Malle Bijoux arrives as an object built for the rituals of modern travel and collecting. Read as a group, the High Trunks make the case that the Monogram is less a print than a platform, one durable enough to survive being cut into leather, embedded in shell, and poured into chrome without losing its identity.First revealed at the Men's Spring-Summer 2027 show, the High Trunks are available in select Louis Vuitton stores worldwide and through the House's Savoir Rêver events. The Mother of Pearl Marquetry, Chrome Wave, Summer Captions, and Liquid Python Courrier Lozine 110 can be ordered with a ten-month lead time, with further pieces from the collection arriving from January 2027.

title: SOPHNET. and L.L.Bean Build the Boat and Tote on 24 oz Heavy Canvas With Scorpion Embroidery
summary:
Summary

SOPHNET. and L.L.Bean base their collaborative tote on L.L.Bean's Boat and Tote using durable 24 oz heavy canvas cottonA SOPHNET. brand-name patch and a scorpion embroidery sit on the black or natural bodyThe bag comes in Large, Medium, and Mini sizes to suit different uses and styling

SOPHNET. and L.L.Bean have reworked the Boat and Tote, building their collaborative version on L.L.Bean's signature carrier and its heavy-duty canvas. The project keeps the tote's functional foundation intact while layering in SOPHNET.'s own graphic detailing, resulting in a bag defined as much by its material as by its branding.The base does the structural work. The tote is made from L.L.Bean's 24 oz heavy canvas cotton, a weight chosen for high durability, and that dense cotton gives the bag its rigidity and hard-wearing character before any graphics enter the picture. It is the same construction logic that underpins the original Boat and Tote, carried over here without dilution.SOPHNET.'s contribution is concentrated in the surface detailing. The black or natural body is fitted with a SOPHNET. brand-name patch alongside a scorpion embroidery, the two elements combining the label's graphic identity with the tote's plain canvas ground. Around the trim, an L.L.Bean tag remains in place, keeping both names present on the finished piece and marking the split of responsibilities between the two.The range is built for flexibility. The tote is offered in three sizes, Large, Medium, and Mini, a spread designed to cover different uses and styling preferences rather than a single fixed format. Together with the choice of black or natural, that three-size structure gives the collaboration a small matrix of configurations built on one durable canvas template.The SOPHNET. x L.L.Bean Boat and Tote releases August 28 via SOPH. title: Shein Prepares for IPO at $27 Billion USD Valuation
summary:
Summary

Shein has officially launched its global offering seeking to raise up to $1.77 billion USD on the Hong Kong Stock ExchangeThe ultra-fast-fashion company is targeting a valuation of roughly $27 billion USD ahead of its planned September 1 trading debutThe public offering comes as the company navigates slowing growth shifting global trade policies and increased fulfillment expenses

Shein has officially launched its global offering, setting the stage for an initial public offering on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange targeting a valuation of roughly $27 billion USD. The ultra-fast-fashion retailer is offering 280 million shares priced between $47.60 HKD and $49.50 HKD to raise up to $13.86 billion HKD (approximately $1.77 billion USD).The company's planned debut follows its listing hearing clearance in July, with financial backing co-sponsored by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JPMorgan. Cornerstone investors behind the offering include Boyu Capital, Tiger Global, General Atlantic, Tencent, Greenwoods Asset Management, and Taikang Life Insurance. The resulting $27 billion USD valuation sits below its pandemic-era peak, placing Shein at roughly 0.7 times forecast sales.The public listing arrives during a challenging fiscal period for the retailer, marked by trade policy shifts such as the removal of de minimis exemptions in the U.S. and European Union. Shein reported a 38.7% drop in net profit to $2.06 billion USD for 2025, followed by a first-quarter 2026 net loss of $99 million USD. To preserve voting power for founder Chris Xu (Xu Yangtian), who holds a 33% stake, the company plans to adopt a dual-class share structure upon going public.The final offer price for Shein's global offering will be set on August 31, 2026, with official trading scheduled to commence on September 1, 2026.

title: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto x NEEDLES Stitch a Rose and a Butterfly Into a Satin Cowboy One-Up Shirt
summary:
Summary

WILDSIDE and NEEDLES build the S/S Cowboy One-up Shirt on a NEEDLES body carrying both labels' signature embroideryTwo NEEDLES butterflies and a WILDSIDE rose are positioned to symbolize the collaboration itselfA smooth satin fabric, boxy Western silhouette, and black snap buttons round out the design

WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and NEEDLES have joined forces on the S/S Cowboy One-up Shirt, a Western-leaning piece that lets each label speak through its own signature embroidery. Constructed on a NEEDLES body, the shirt pairs the brand's butterfly motif with WILDSIDE's rose, framing the collaboration as a literal meeting of two emblems on a single garment.The embroidery does the heavy lifting. Two NEEDLES butterflies land across the chest and back alongside WILDSIDE's rose, and the placement of those butterflies is deliberate, arranged to stand in for the partnership rather than sit as decoration. The detail that seals it is on the reverse: the back rose is stitched in a purple made exclusively for this release, a small flourish that keeps the piece from reading as a straight logo swap between two houses. The butterfly has long been a NEEDLES calling card and the rose a WILDSIDE fixture, so seeing them share one panel is the entire point.Underneath the graphics, the make is where the shirt earns its price of entry. It is cut from a smooth satin with a refined sheen and soft hand, a blend of triacetate, cupra, and polyester that gives the Western shape a dressier finish than the cowboy reference might suggest. The silhouette stays boxy with a moderate length and subtle stripes running through the fabric, while black snap buttons add a sharp, low-key accent against the sheen. It is finished in Japan, and the rayon embroidery threads keep the surface work crisp against the satin ground.Framed together, the two elements tell the collaboration's story cleanly. The Western template and satin build give the shirt its body, and the paired embroidery gives it its reason to exist, a compact example of two Japanese labels trading motifs instead of simply co-signing a blank. That the collaboration is capped at one per customer only underlines how it is being positioned, as a limited handshake between WILDSIDE and NEEDLES rather than a broad rollout.The WILDSIDE x NEEDLES S/S Cowboy One-up Shirt releases August 26 via WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO.

Utilizing silkscreen printing techniques engineered to replicate the look and feel of vintage 1990s movie apparel, the designs incorporate the film's iconic "Yellow Labyrinth" imagery alongside graphics that reflect its unsettling atmosphere. The Backrooms x GEEKS RULE tees span three distinct volumes priced at ¥11,000 JPY and ¥13,200 JPY.For The Drama, the pop-up offers official logo T-shirts priced at ¥7,700 JPY. The pieces feature the film's title alongside classic A24 branding across black, white, and burgundy colorways. title: 「日本の美意識は私たちのデザインに近い」アイビー・ロスが語るGoogle Store 表参道
summary: 2026年8月、東京・明治神宮前交差点に面した東急プラザ表参道「オモカド」に、グーグルの直営店「Google Store 表参道」がオープンした。 　2021年にニューヨークのチェルシー地区で最初のGoogle Storeがオープンしてから米国で10店舗を開いたが、米国外はこの店が初めて。同時に、これまでで最大規模の店舗で、地下1階、1階、2階の3フロア構成。同社の日本市場への意気込みは、この店だけに用意されたアート作品や日本限定グッズからも伝わってくる。 　ストアでは、PixelスマートフォンやPixel Watchをはじめとする最新のGoogle製品、同店限定品を含むオリジナルグッズを販売。AIで自分のアバターを生成できるプリクラのような体験をはじめ、グーグルの最新技術を試せるコーナーを2階に設けるほか、地下1階では修理や専門スタッフへの相談にも対応する。店内の各所には、Google製品の世界観や製造背景を紹介する展示がちりばめられている。 　店のデザインを手掛けたのは、グーグルのチーフ・デザイン・オフィサー、アイビー・ロス（Ivy Ross）。「カルバン・クライン（Calvin Klein）」「コーチ（COACH）」「スウォッチ（Swatch）」「ギャップ（Gap）」のほか、マテル（Mattel）社などで製品デザインやブランド、マーケティングの要職を歴任し、2014年、スマートグラス「Google Glass」の責任者としてグーグルに入社した。2016年に発足したハードウェアデザインチームのトップに就任し、「ハードウェアを機械ではなく、日々身につけ、触れ、感情を重ねるものとして考える」という姿勢のもと、柔らかなフォルムや温かみのある色使い、一目でGoogle製品と分かる個性を備えたPixelシリーズなどの世界観をつくってきた人物だ。 　大盛況だったオープン翌日の早朝、帰国を前にしたロスが、空港へ向かうまでの短い時間、インタビューに応じてくれた。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: FC Barcelona Debuts Kobe Bryant-Inspired "Barça Mamba" Away Kit
summary:
Summary

FC Barcelona has officially debuted its new Barça Mamba away kit on the pitch against Elche CFThe jersey features a striking purple and yellow colorway inspired by Kobe Bryant and his Mamba MentalityThe match debut coincided directly with Kobe Bryant's birthday

FC Barcelona has officially debuted its new "Barça Mamba" away kit on the pitch during a match against Elche CF. Taking the field on Kobe Bryant’s birthday, the Spanish club honored the legendary athlete by bringing his iconic spirit directly to football.The kit showcases a striking purple and yellow design, drawing direct visual inspiration from Kobe Bryant’s court-side legacy. Built around the ethos of Bryant’s signature "Mamba Mentality," the jersey translates court-side focus and relentless drive straight onto the pitch. The jerseys feature a black to purple gradient from the shoulders to the bottom of the shirt, while the shorts come in all-purple but with a subtle snakeskin texture pattern as a nod to the Black Mamba. The socks, shorts and jersey all feature the signature sheath logo which received an iridescent transformation. The team's track jacket also received a "Barça Mamba" makeover, arriving in black and purple snakeskin texture to match the aesthetic. On the other hand, the goalie jersey is entirely in a golden yellow snakeskin pattern, keeping in line with the purple and gold team Bryant spent his entire career.The FC Barcelona "Barça Mamba" away kit made its official on-pitch debut against Elche CF and are now available online at FC Barça's site. title: SKIMS' New Chief Design Officer Spent 22 Years at Supreme
summary:
SummarySKIMS hired former Supreme veteran Erin Magee as its first-ever Chief Design Officer.Simultaneously, the brand promoted Kim Schraub to the newly created role of Chief Brand Officer.On August 24, SKIMS officially announced that designer Erin Magee was hired on as the brand's first-ever Chief Design Officer, along with the promotion of Kim Schraub to Chief Brand Officer. Kim Kardashian's shapewear and apparel label made the announcement just days after Magee shared her departure from Supreme, ending her 22-year tenure at the legendary streetwear label.In an official statement provided to WWD, Magee said, "Skims has done something rare: built a brand that is both deeply personal and universal." "The commitment to design, innovation, and solutions for every body is genuinely inspiring, and I’m excited to help shape what comes next. I look forward to working alongside this talented team to push the creative boundaries of the brand and create products that people truly connect with,” she added. As SKIMS continues to expand its international presence and product mix, the Supreme veteran and Mademe founder will be tasked with supervising design and creative product direction.On August 20, Magee posted her goodbye on Instagram: “It has been the honor of a lifetime to be part of the World Famous Supreme Team." She had been with the brand since 2004, holding multiple positions throughout her tenure. In 2007, Magee launched Mademe, a women’s streetwear brand that has released collaborations with major brands like Doc Martens, Alpha Industries, and Courtney Love‘s band Hole.Kim Kardashian commented on the new appointment, saying, "I’ve admired Erin’s work for years. The way she approaches design with such a strong point of view while staying completely connected to her audience is something I deeply respect." "She understands what it means to build something that truly resonates, and I’m so excited to welcome her to Skims," she added.Stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights.

title: SAN SAN GEAR FW26 Explores Urban Connectivity With “CABLE”
summary:
Summary

SAN SAN GEAR FW26 “CABLE” explores unseen urban networks through layered silhouettes and technical fabrics.Key styles include multi‑layered outerwear, structural knitwear and modular bags.Released in three drops starting today, via flagship, online and select retailers.

South Korean technical streetwear brand SAN SAN GEAR returns with its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, titled "CABLE," which explores urban connectivity and the unseen networks shaping city life. The collection explores the unseen connections that shape urban life, drawing inspiration from fleeting encounters and invisible networks.The sartorial lineup alongside its conceptual campaign draws from its concept, which imagines strangers linked by an intangible cable, expressed through layered silhouettes, technical fabrics, and accessories that merge utility with subcultural streetwear. Key pieces include multi‑layered outerwear with cable‑like detailing, oversized knitwear with structural patterns, and modular bags designed for adaptability. The palette reflects muted city tones punctuated by sharp accents, reinforcing the theme of hidden networks beneath everyday structures.The collection will be released in three drops: August 24, September 3, and September 30, 2026. Items will be available through SAN SAN GEAR’s flagship store, its official online shop, as well as select retailers. View this post on Instagram A post shared by SAN SAN GEAR (@sansan_gear)

title: The G-Dragon x CASETiFY “Make It Yours” Collection Is Available Now
summary:
Summary

CASETiFY and G-DRAGON drop "MAKE IT YOURS," expanding device protection into a customizable, charm-based accessory ecosystem.Key Accessories includes Glaze and Mirror Impact Cases, Love Lock magnetic charms, Alphabet Plush characters, and customized Bounce Suitcases.

CASETiFY has marked its 15th anniversary with a new collaboration alongside G-Dragon, unveiling the "MAKE IT YOURS" collection. Expanding beyond device protection, the release introduces the CASETiFY PLAYSET, a customizable ecosystem of phone cases, charms, wristlets, grip stands and travel gear designed to mix, match and stack.At the core of the collection is the upgraded Impact Case, available with a high‑gloss Glaze backplate or reflective Mirror backplate, paired with ten expressive prints in vibrant candy tones. The lineup also includes Jelly Wristlets, Snappy™ Candy Mirror Grip Stands, and Glitter Silicone Charm Cubes, all powered by the proprietary Love Lock magnetic system for seamless attachment and personalization.The broader accessory lineup debuts modular attachments engineered around CASETiFY's magnetic Love Lock system, allowing users to stack Jelly Wristlets, Snappy™ Candy Mirror Grip Stands, and Glitter Silicone Charm Cubes. A key highlight of the drop is the all-new CASETiFY Alphabet Plush series — a whimsical collection of tactile character charms designed to clip directly onto phone cases or bags.The collection also extends to travel gear via the customized Bounce Suitcase and offers three curated starter bundles: the ICON PLAYSET, LOVE POP PLAYSET and NOVA PLAYSET, each packaged with exclusive G-DRAGON photo cards and sticker sets. title: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week
summary:
Summary

Led by a Betty Boop collabortive capsule with Fleischer Studios, featuring the iconic character across chenille varsity jackets, graphic tees and headwear. Mainline seasonal drop highlights sporty pieces like the Big Ripstop jacket, Dove Stamp waffle tops as well as Legacy hoodies, polos and more.Lands August 28 globally and August 29 across Asia.

Continuing its Fall 2026 seasonal rollout, Palace Skateboards is back to deliver the fourth drop of the season, headlined by an official collaboration with Fleischer Studios celebrating the iconic cartoon heroine Betty Boop. Reinterpreting historic pop-culture figures through its distinct skate-led design language, the London imprint recontextualizes the classic character across a dedicated range of apparel and accessories. Throughout the capsule, Betty Boop appears wearing her own custom take on the signature Tri-Ferg logo, set against classic Palace script, playful feline companions, heart motifs and lipstick-kissed graphics.Leading the collaborative assortment are statement varsity jackets detailed with rich chenille embroidery, alongside comfortable fleece hooded sweatshirts, woven button-down shirts and graphic T-shirts. Headwear options complete the capsule with co-branded caps and knit beanies, including a standout style featuring a knit graphic of Betty Boop wearing Palace-branded hoop earrings.Alongside the collaborative delivery, Palce also readies its fourth season delivery, focusing on rugged utility and versatile transitional layering pieces. The core offering is anchored by the Big Ripstop Jacket and matching Big Ripstop Joggers, constructed from durable technical fabrics in Army Black, Army Navy and Army Olive colorways. Joining the military-influenced aesthetic is the Dove Stamp Waffle Long-Sleeve, which arrives in Army Olive, Snow Camo and Black to provide breathable textured warmth for shifting temperatures.Rounding out the mainline delivery is the Legacy collection, featuring a coordinated polo, hoodie, and jogger set offered in timeless Black, Navy, and Woodland Camo colorways. Palace Skateboards’ Betty Boop capsule and Fall 2026 Drop 4 will release in-store and online on August 28, 2026, at 11 a.m. BST /EDT across the UK, Europe, the US and Canada. The collection will subsequently land in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong and South Korea on August 29.

title: 「タナカ ダイスケ」5年目の現在地　ものづくりの美学、G-DRAGON衣装制作のきっかけも
summary: FASHIONSNAPでは、ファッション領域を中心に日々さまざまな新世代のつくり手を取材している。そして気がつくのは、いつの時代も新たな才能を持つ若者がカルチャーの担い手であるということ。そこで、今日から始まる「次世代クリエイター」特集では、ファッションとその周縁を取り巻くアップカミングなクリエイターたちにフォーカスしていく。 　まずは、設立5年以下で独自の世界観を持ち、今後の活躍に注目が寄せられるファッションデザイナー3人を紹介。トップバッターに選んだのは「タナカ ダイスケ（tanakadaisuke）」を手掛ける田中大資だ。設立5年でショーの開催や国内ファッションアワードの受賞、パリでの展示会の実施など堅実な歩みを進めている。卸先は国内16店舗、海外5店舗と、ビジネス面はまだまだ伸び代があるが、繊細な刺繍やビジューを散りばめた装飾は舞台映えが抜群で、BIGBANGのG-DRAGONを筆頭にK-POPや著名アーティストがステージ衣装に次々と起用。エンタメの世界からも熱視線を集め存在感を放つ。特定の誰かのための衣装制作と、ブランドとして多くの人に届けるクリエイションの両輪が相乗効果を生み出し独自路線を走る。 　大人になってもときめきを忘れずにファッションを楽しむ心に寄り添い、混沌とした毎日を生きるための“おまじない”のような服でコアなファンを増やすタナカ ダイスケ。5年の節目を迎え、変わらないことと変わったこと、10年目に向けたブランドらしさとの向き合い方を聞いた。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

UNIQLO has officially announced the Uniqlo U 10th Anniversary Collection for Fall/Winter 2026. title: Two Souls Bound by Impulse: The Cinematic Poetry of Valentino’s “Vendetta”
summary:
Summary

Romain Gavras directs Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgård in a 35mm campaign film for Valentino Beauty's newest fragrance, Vendetta.Vendetta is made up of two scents: the tuberose-driven "Vendetta Donna" alongside the ginger and cinnamon-based "Vendetta Uomo."

Valentino Beauty unveils a magnetic return to passion with its new prestige fragrance duo, Vendetta, brought to life in a campaign film starring Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgård.Directed by Romain Gavras and photographed by Inez & Vinoodh, the cinematic narrative unfolds on 35mm film as an intimate, instinctive escape set against the driving rhythms of Pet Shop Boys’ "It’s a Sin." Set between sunlit highways and hushed, shadowed interiors, Johnson and Skarsgård embody two rebellious souls bound by an undeniable energy, orbiting one another in a shared pursuit of freedom.Throughout the film, Valentino's signature red weaves through key visual moments - from flowing dresses to subtle gestures - acting as a visceral symbol of sensuality, intensity, and the tension of what is yet to unfold. The duo expresses this passion through two distinct olfactory signatures. "Vendetta Donna," composed by Dominique Ropion and Andrew Everett, is a floral gourmand woody scent centering on a luminous, carnal Tuberose Osmobloom™. It opens with a burst of juicy red orange nectar before settling into a warm, lingering sandalwood base.Its counterpart, "Vendetta Uomo", crafted by Marie Salamagne, is a woody spicy gourmand built on textural contrasts. Opening with a shot of Peruvian ginger CO2 extract and fresh Italian citrus, the scent unfolds into an addictive heart of cinnamon liquor before anchoring itself in structured patchouli and carnal woods.Matching the intensity of the scent narrative, the bottle design captures pure couture architecture. Sculpted with a bold graphic "V" motif integrated into the glass silhouette, each vessel features a pleated cap inspired by the delicate fabric folds of Valentino garments. The deep crimson juice of "Vendetta Donna" and the rich cognac amber of "Vendetta Uomo" glow through the structured glass, visually completing the story of magnetic connection.The new fragrances are available via Valentino Beauty's website and boutiques. Watch the campaign film starring Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgård below.

title: Nike Unveils Official 'One Piece' Footwear and Apparel Collection
summary:
Summary

Nike has partnered with the 'One Piece' manga franchise for an extensive footwear and apparel capsuleThe collection features three Devil Fruit-inspired expressions of the Nike Air Max Plus alongside co-branded jerseys t-shirts caps and a vestThe release debuts through regional pop-ups in Tokyo on September 4 followed by a global launch on September 25

Nike has officially announced an upcoming footwear and apparel collection inspired by the world-renowned manga franchise One Piece. Blending sportswear heritage with global pop culture, the partnership translates key lore from the storyline into specialized footwear executions and co-branded apparel.At the center of the collection are three distinct colorways of the Nike Air Max Plus featuring completely retooled uppers exclusive to the partnership. Each design takes direct inspiration from specific Devil Fruits found within the storyline: the Gomu Gomu no Mi, Ope Ope no Mi, and Mera Mera no Mi. "We were inspired by the superhuman abilities that are unleashed when One Piece characters eat the Devil Fruits, much like the feeling an athlete has when they put on a pair of Nikes," said Nick Remlinger, GM of Energy Gaming at Nike.The apparel lineup complements the footwear with Air Max Plus jerseys and caps pulled directly from the Nike archives. T-shirts incorporate classic Nike ad styling merged with manga illustrations alongside the Jolly Roger graphic drawn by Monkey D. Luffy. The range is rounded out by a specialized vest inspired by the lore of the Devil Fruits, which render those who eat them unable to swim.The Nike x One Piece collection debuts through special pop-up and retail experiences starting September 4, 2026, in Tokyo, releasing at HBX on September 12, followed by a global release on September 25, 2026, via SNKRS.

title: Palace Skateboards Unveils Third Seoul Store and Exclusive Capsule Collection
summary:
Summary

Palace Skateboards is expanding its retail footprint in South Korea with the opening of its third Seoul store inside Lotte World MallThe interior design draws structural cues from Jongmyo Shrine incorporating corduroy-fluted concrete columns stained teak paneling and custom UK DPM camouflage carpetTo mark the launch Palace is dropping a store-exclusive apparel capsule featuring graphics inspired by Seoul Olympic Park and Lotte World mascots

Palace Skateboards has officially announced its third retail location in South Korea, Palace Seoul Lotte World Mall, opening alongside an exclusive commemorative apparel collection. Situated inside Lotte World Mall near the 555-metre Lotte World Tower in Jamsil, the 142.57-square-metre space merges the London skate label’s retail identity with traditional local architecture.Continuing a design narrative that previously referenced royal Korean palaces, Moon Jars, and London's brutalist Southbank skate scene, the new flagship turns to Seoul’s historic Jongmyo Shrine for visual inspiration. The store’s linear layout echoes the shrine's horizontal continuity, framed by round concrete columns with corduroy-fluted finishes, stained teak paneling, mirrored walls, and camouflage marble. Decorative installations include a faceted mirror-glass skateboard deck display, an infinity mirrored 3D LED tri-ferg, a freestanding LED video wall, UK DPM camouflage carpeting, and Palace’s signature oversized bulldog sculpture.To celebrate the grand opening, Palace is releasing a store-exclusive collection of limited-edition apparel and accessories. The release features technical shell jackets, shorts, hoodies, and T-shirts finished with Olympic-inspired graphics that pay homage to nearby Seoul Olympic Park in Songpa District. Additional graphic details integrate Lotty and Lorry, the official raccoon mascots of Lotte World Adventure.The Palace Skateboards Seoul Lotte World Mall store and its exclusive launch capsule officially open on Saturday, August 22, 2026.PALACE SKATEBOARDS SEOULLotte World Mall 1F300 Olympic-roSongpa-gu, Seoul

title: Fugazi Draws Crowds for $5 Shoes & Supreme Chief Creative Steps Down in This Week's Top Fashion News
summary:
SummarySupreme’s CCO departed after 22 years, while Palace Skateboards and Reese Cooper expanded with new retail spaces.Fugazi dropped a canceled collaboration with Vans for just $5.Reebok debuted 3D-printed kicks, and Awake NY delivered bootleg-inspired luxury Air Jordan 6s.How a Cancelled Fugazi x Vans Collab Led to $5 USD ShoesWhen Vans canceled its highly anticipated collaboration with streetwear label Fugazi, the brand took matters into its own hands with a bold move. The initial partnership drew heavy backlash from fans of the anti-consumerist punk band also named Fugazi, who deemed the project tone-deaf. Vans executives quickly terminated the deal to respect the band's ethos. Unfazed, the clothing brand launched a discreet, cash-only drop from a branded van in New York and Los Angeles. Despite the corporate ax, the shoes were sold to massive, eager crowds for a mere $5 USD. Fugazi cheekily blurred out the footwear in all release photos, adding a final rebellious wink to the defunct campaign.Supreme Chief Creative Officer Steps Down After 22 YearsErin Magee stepped down as Supreme’s Chief Creative Officer, closing a monumental 22-year chapter with the New York streetwear giant. The designer, who joined the label in 2004, announced her departure on Instagram. Magee played a pivotal role in shaping Supreme's identity, but she's now expected to shift focus to Mademe, her women’s streetwear label founded in 2007. Her exit adds another layer of uncertainty to Supreme’s recent instability, which included multiple corporate buyouts and the controversial departure of former Creative Director Tremaine Emory. With the creative director position already vacant, Magee’s departure leaves significant questions about who may steer the iconic brand's future vision.Palace Skateboards to Open Third South Korean Store in SeoulPalace Skateboards has announced plans to officially open its third offline store in South Korea with Palace Jamsil on August 22. Nestled inside the capital city's largest shopping mall. The store's interior reportedly draws architectural inspiration from a South Korean UNESCO World Heritage Site. To celebrate the flagship opening, Palace will release an exclusive collection available only on-site at the Jamsil location. The expansion plan further solidifies the label's growing following within the Asian streetwear market.Reese Cooper Opens RC Outdoor Supply Retail Store in Los AngelesReese Cooper has expanded his retail footprint by opening the first physical RC Outdoor Supply store in Los Angeles. Located in Silverlake, the 806-square-foot flagship was designed in collaboration with creative studio PlayLab Inc. to serve as the home base for the designer's outdoor-focused apparel and RCI footwear. The brick-and-mortar space brings Cooper's function-driven pieces engineered for harsh environments into an IRL environment — including his taped-seam shell jackets, insulated outerwear, and trademarked Hook hardware. Operating daily, the outpost brings his blend of Americana heritage and technical trail readiness directly to the Southern California community.Reebok and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Question 96/26Reebok and Zellerfeld have come together, transforming Allen Iverson’s first signature sneaker into the 3D-printed Question 96/26. This futuristic style kicks off the 30th-anniversary celebrations for the original Reebok Question released in 1996. The refreshed and remodelled footwear maintained the classic sweeping proportions and iconic honeycomb cushioning geometry, but updated with a fluid, digitally native structure. Released in "Lilac" and "Stone," the shoes brought the recognizable heritage silhouette into the growing 3D-printed ecosystem. The Reebok Question 96/26 drops in limited quantities on August 25, 2026, at 12 p.m. ET, available exclusively via Zellerfeld for $169 USD.Awake NY and Jordan Brand Flip Bootleg Culture for AJ6 CollaborationJordan Brand and Awake NY celebrated the Air Jordan 6's 35th anniversary with the release of a new capsule deeply inspired by New York bootleg culture. Inspired by founder Angelo Baque’s early memories of street market knockoffs, the design subverted the sneaker's codes with exaggerated color blocking and unconventional stitching. Despite the bootleg aesthetic, the craftsmanship remained strictly premium, utilizing Saffiano leather, Game Royal nubuck, and vibrant Infrared 23 detailing. The collaboration also featured a full ready-to-wear apparel capsule, including a matching tracksuit and an elevated polo. An online EQL raffle for the Awake NY x Air Jordan 6 sneaker opens on August 23, 2026. The full capsule will officially release on August 24, 2026, dropping online via Awake NY as well as in-store at its NYC location.

title: Diptyque Debuts “Les Rituels de Soin” Body Care and Artisanal Home Range

Summary

Diptyque's Les Rituels de Soin Collection draws inspiration from ancient bathing rituals.Morning and evening routines feature candles, gels, oils, scrubs and balms crafted with natural ingredients.Releasing in September, the collection includes decorative objects, refillable packaging, and sustainable materials like recycled oyster shell terrazzo.

Diptyque has unveiled its Les Rituels de Soin Collection, a holistic body care line that will officially release next month. Inspired by ancient bathing customs, the collection is designed to reconnect body and soul through sensorial rituals that blend fragrance, texture and gesture.Overseen by perfumer Nathalie Cetto, every formula features up to 100% natural ingredients, transforming each fragrance into a scientifically measured active ingredient that enhances emotional well-being. Anchoring the range are two core rituals: the energizing Morning Ritual - led by the Le Matin vegetable-noted candle, an awakening Dry Body Brush and a bergamot and sweet almond milk Nurturing Cleansing Gel - and the soothing Evening Ritual, which centers around the chamomile-infused Le Soir candle, a roasted barley and rose Rich Soothing Body Balm, and a contour-sculpting Ceramic Gua Sha.Complementing the care products, Diptyque has introduced a series of decorative objects that extend the rituals into everyday life. These include lacquered wood trays, tissue boxes, and mirror boxes illustrated by Julie Serre, as well as biscuit porcelain apothecary jars crafted by Manufacture de Couleuvre. The Maison also debuts terrazzo pocket mirrors made from recycled oyster shells and a two-tone Oval Travel Bag in recycled canvas, reinforcing its commitment to sustainability.The Les Rituels de Soin Collection will be available through Diptyque boutiques and online starting September 2026.

Following up on its earlier release this month, EVANGELION:95 returns with the second delivery of its seasonal collection, continuing to translate iconic scenes and motifs from the original Neon Genesis Evangelion anime and The End of Evangelion film into everyday wardrobe staples. The new drop comprises four distinct graphic T-shirts, two cap variants and a statement scarf.Leading the tee selection is the white 0104 T-Shirt, which showcases a grid layout of the series' core female characters from the 1995 opening sequence. Meanwhile, the dark-toned 0106 T-Shirt presents an ominous visual of the crucified Lilith inside Terminal Dogma. Drenched in deep purple, the 0102 T-Shirt captures EVA Unit-01's long-range sniper attack against the 5th Angel from Episode 6. Rounding out the apparel, the white 0107 T-Shirt immortalizes a pivotal Third Impact scene from The End of Evangelion, depicting Unit-01 emerging from the third eye of the Rei/Lilith hybrid.On the accessories front, the 0124 Cap arrives in black and brown with a subtly distressed finish, featuring heavy-metal-style "MASS PRODUCTION MODEL" embroidery above an embroidered Spear of Longinus and splattered red dots that evoke the film's climactic battle. Closing out the release, the 0120 Stole is emblazoned with Yu Honda's iconic illustration of an injured Rei Ayanami floating in a pool of LCL. The full delivery is available now via the EVANGELION:95 webstore, with prices ranging from ¥16,500 to ¥26,400 JPY (approx. 104–166 USD).

title: Supreme Chief Creative Officer Steps Down After 22 Years
summary:
SummaryErin Magee stepped down as Supreme's Chief Creative Officer after 22 years, likely to focus on her growing label, Mademe.Her exit adds to Supreme's recent instability, following Tremaine Emory's controversial resignation and successive corporate buyouts.On August 20, Supreme Chief Creative Officer Erin Magee announced her departure via Instagram after more than two decades at the NYC-born streetwear label. “It has been the honor of a lifetime to be part of the World Famous Supreme Team,” she shared in the post.Magee had been with the brand since 2004, having held several positions during her tenure. Since the brand’s early days, she has been behind the development and direction of some of the brand's most iconic pieces and collaborative projects. In 2007, Magee launched women's streetwear brand Mademe, which she may very well center her focus on now that she has departed from Supreme. The Mademe label has continued to grow in the 2020s, capturing major partnerships with brands like Doc Martens, Alpha Industries, and Courtney Love's band Hole. View this post on Instagram A post shared by erin_mademe (@erin_mademe)The news is only the latest reshuffle to come from the brand in recent years, including its 2020 VF Corp acquisition, designer Tremaine Emory’s sudden departure from his new Creative Director role in 2023, and VF’s sale of the label to EssilorLuxottica in 2024. Emory's departure, only a year after his appointment, was particularly controversial as he cited internal discrimination as the reason for his decision. Since then, the brand has left the Creative Director position without replacement. Supreme has yet to announce who will fill Magee's long-held CCO role.Stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights.

title: Dead Kennedys and UNDER R Merge Hardcore Punk Archive and Streetwear
summary:
Summary

UNDER R partners with San Francisco punk band Dead Kennedys on an archival artwork capsule.Features ZINE-collaged shirts, album art tees, jackets, caps, and socks with custom co-branded neck tags.Drops August 22, 2026, in-store and online via UNDER R.

Japanese retailer UNDER R has partnered with seminal 1970s San Francisco hardcore punk band Dead Kennedys for a collaborative apparel capsule.Fusing music, subcultural art and modern streetwear, the collection curates iconic visual assets from the band’s extensive archive. The lineup translates archival album covers, rare concert flyer art and collaged ZINE graphics across a range of streetwear staples, spanning T-shirts, long-sleeve shirts, jackets, caps and socks. Each item carries a custom collar tag combining the Dead Kennedys’ iconic logo with UNDER R’s Old English branding, underscoring the authenticity of the collaboration.To mark the partnership, every piece is finished with a custom co-branded neck label combining the Dead Kennedys' emblem with UNDER R’s signature Old English logo. The Dead Kennedys x UNDER R collection officially releases on August 22, 2026, dropping in-store and online through UNDER R.

title: UNION Subverts Industrial Uniforms for New Dickies Collaboration
summary:
Summary

UNION and Dickies drop a capsule flipping classic workwear inside out with exposed seams.Features inverted chore jackets, Eisenhower-style tops, double-knee work pants, and graphic T-shirts.Drops today online and across UNION Los Angeles and Tokyo flagships.

UNION has joined forces with Dickies for a collaborative Fall/Winter 2026 capsule titled "INVERSE." True to its name, the collection reimagines Dickies' classic utilitarian silhouettes by flipping traditional garment construction inside out. The design language highlights exposed seams, inverted fabric textures, and contrast stitching across Dickies' signature heavy-duty cotton twill. By subverting industrial uniforms into elevated street staples, the joint project bridges Union’s refined West Coast streetwear aesthetic with Dickies' century-old workwear legacy.The "INVERSE" capsule centers around a set of co-branded workwear suits, featuring unstructured chore jackets and wide-leg Eisenhower-style tops paired with matching double-knee work pants and relaxed trousers. Each piece is finished with dual logo patches, exposed interior taping, and subtle contrast stitching that emphasizes the collection's inside-out theme. The lineup is further complemented by graphic T-shirts and daily layering tops.The UNION x Dickies “INVERSE” collection officially releases today via UNION's official webstore and in-store across UNION flagship locations in Los Angeles and Tokyo.

WIND AND SEA  Reunite With ‘Parappa the Rapper’ for a Special 30th Anniversary Collection
summary:
Summary

WIND AND SEA pairs with 'PaRappa the Rapper' for a 30th-anniversary capsule featuring new Rodney Greenblat artwork.Includes rhinestone tees, "96" zip hoodies, kids' apparel, keyholders and woven lifestyle blankets.Launches August 22, 2026, alongside a special pop-up at Shinsaibashi PARCO.

WIND AND SEA has reconnected with PaRappa the Rapper once more for a commemorative collection celebrating the rhythm game’s 30th anniversary. Highlighting original artwork newly created by character designer Rodney A. Greenblat, the collection translates the franchise's playful 1990s visual aesthetic into WIND AND SEA’s signature street-ready silhouettes.The lineup includes T-shirts featuring PaRappa’s artwork, rhinestone-detailed designs, pencil-style illustrations, and “96” motifs referencing the character’s 1996 debut. Zip-up hoodies, knit caps, obi-style belts, and necklaces expand the apparel range, while lifestyle items such as blankets, phone grips, magnets, and multi-trays bring PaRappa’s world into everyday use. Kids’ sizes are also available, allowing families to coordinate looks across generations.Key accessories include PaRappa-branded knit caps, pillbox hats, obi-style belts, and silver or gold chain necklaces. The lifestyle lineup is further rounded out by character keyholders spotlighting Master Onion and PJ Berri, custom phone grips, air fresheners, multi-trays and co-branded woven blankets.To mark the release, a dedicated 30th-anniversary pop-up event will run at Shinsaibashi PARCO from August 19 through September 1, 2026. The full collection officially launches globally on August 22, 2026, via the WIND AND SEA webstore and select retail outposts. View this post on Instagram

title: Bode Is in the Peak of Its Cowboy Era for SS27
summary:
SummaryBode’s SS27 collection reimagines the 1865-1890s American cowboy era, blending ornate Western styles with contemporary, wearable staples.Signature details include playful cow prints, subtle rodeo motifs, heavy suede and leather fringing, and intricately decorated denim.As a continuation of the FW26 Rodeo Bodeo concept, Bode designer Emily Adams Bode Aujla explores signature Western styles with a timeless touch for SS27. Centering on “the peak of the American cowboy era” (circa 1865 - 1890s), the latest range features strong cowboy cultural references combined with the ornate embellishments and durable materials of the time.Standing out immediately is a women's look featuring a brown cow print bikini and jacket, a high-exposure contemporary number that grounds this time-hopping collection in the present. The pattern continues in a men's look comprising a jacket and shorts outlined by matching green trims and styled with a green striped tee. Other fabrics incorporate cowboy motifs like rope tricks and horses in colorful patterns. Some executions are more discreet than others: a gray animal print is superimposed with blue cowboys in mid-lasso form, which are only visible with a closer glimpse.Suede and leather fringe play a major role in imbuing the broader collection with a cowboy feel. Brown leather riding pants are emphasized with a short fringe finish up the legs, while multiple jackets, including a red blouson with a decorative yoke, feature more dramatic fringe moments. Denim also continues as a main staple for SS27, featured in a camp-collar long-sleeve adorned with star rivets at the pocket and a chore jacket, decorated with folk-style trims around the collar, pockets, and cuffs.Styled with a certain ease true to the present, the overall collection goes heavy on Western-inspiration through statement pieces while grounding it in a foundation of wearable staples like the t-shirts, trousers, and tailored ensembles.See the full Bode SS27 collection in the gallery above.

title: 8 Drops You Don't Want to Miss This Week
summary:
With another week upon us, we have yet another installment of our product drops series.This week’s lineup of drops kicks off with Supreme officially launching its FW26 season with a massive collection featuring a Jeff Hamilton Box Logo leather jacket and a chromed-out motor scooter. Palace Skateboards follows with its Fall 2026 Drop 3, blending an archive baseball collaboration alongside Ebbets Field Flannels with biker-inspired moto gear. Drake's OVO reconnects with the UFC for a fighter-inspired apparel capsule fronted by Canadian welterweight Mike Malott, while Shinsuke Takizawa’s NEIGHBORHOOD doubles down on motorcycle subculture, military workwear, and punk aesthetics for its moody FW26 delivery. Technical outerwear takes center stage as Descente unveils its thermal-bonded "Mizusawa Down" FW26 range built at its newly rebuilt factory, while PLEASURES explores subcultural nostalgia and transitional layering in its "Somewhere In Between" collection. C2H4® translates 1950s mid-century interior design into contemporary urban menswear, and closing out the week, Bear Walker teams up with ONE PIECE for custom-carved, holographic Devil Fruit blindbox skate decks.Check out this week’s 8 drops you don’t want to miss below.Supreme FW26 Collection Drop 1Supreme officially kicks off its Fall/Winter 2026 season with the reveal of its complete apparel and accessories lineup. The expansive collection balances premium fabrications and fine art co-signs with heavy-duty outerwear, headlined by a standout Jeff Hamilton leather jacket adorned with an all-over patchwork appliqué of historical Box Logos. Alongside reimagined streetwear staples and artistic collaborations—including works by Rita Ackermann and Masato Kawajo—the brand pushes its accessory game to new heights with offerings like a chromed-out motor scooter and a Kodak Super 8 camera. Supreme’s FW26 collection will begin its initial rollout on August 20 globally through the brand's physical flagships and official webstore, followed by a release in Asia.Palace Skateboards Fall 2026 Drop 3Palace Skateboards continues its Fall 2026 rollout with its third delivery, anchored by a nostalgic collaboration with heritage sportswear manufacturer Ebbets Field Flannels. The capsule honors the archive graphics of historic baseball franchises like the Negro League's New York Cubans and Japan's Sankei Atoms across jersey-lined coach jackets, mesh V-necks, and wool ballcaps. Meanwhile, the mainline drop leans heavily into biker-inspired racing aesthetics and religious iconography, highlighted by the padded "Highway to Heaven" moto jacket and the neon wire-embroidered "Pray For Us" hoodie. Palace’s Fall 2026 Drop 3 is set to release on August 21 online and instores across the UK, EU, US and Canada, followed by an August 22 launch in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, and China.OVO x UFC CollaborationDrake's October's Very Own (OVO) and the UFC have reconnected for their second collaborative apparel collection, enlisting Canadian UFC welterweight Mike Malott to front the official campaign. The lifestyle capsule is designed to seamlessly bridge the intense world of mixed martial arts with premium contemporary fashion. The offering features an array of co-branded garments, including hoodies, athletic jerseys, graphic T-shirts, and long-sleeve shirts that combine fighter-inspired artwork with OVO's signature owl iconography. The highly anticipated OVO x UFC 2026 capsule is scheduled to release on August 21 through OVO’s physical flagships and official online store.NEIGHBORHOOD FW26 CollectionShinsuke Takizawa’s NEIGHBORHOOD is gearing up for the colder months with its comprehensive Fall/Winter 2026 collection, doubling down on the brand’s signature fusion of motorcycle subculture, military workwear, and punk aesthetics. Grounded in a moody palette of charcoal, faded indigo, and rich earth tones, the seasonal wardrobe is led by a heavy-duty outerwear selection that includes leather jackets, wool coats, and elaborately embroidered bombers. Staying true to its "Craft With Pride" ethos, the brand rounds out the collection with distressed knit sweaters, versatile button-ups, and adaptable bottom wear. The NEIGHBORHOOD FW26 collection officially launches on August 22 via the brand’s online store and select global retailers.Descente “Mizusawa Down” FW26 Collection Japanese technical label Descente has unveiled its premium “Mizusawa Down” Fall/Winter 2026 outerwear range, crafted at its newly rebuilt Mizusawa factory. The collection introduces a refined evolution of its signature non-quilted, thermal-bonded down jackets, engineered to merge minimalist urban styling with extreme weather performance. Flagship models like the "MOUNTAINEER," "ANCHOR," and "SHUTTLE-L" return with modernized shell fabrics and reworked functional details, joined by the debut of the limited, cold-weather "EXPEDITION" variant. An advance pre-order phase for the Descente "Mizusawa Down" FW26 collection begins on August 21 through the brand's official webstore, with subsequent global rollouts scheduled for September 18 and October 23.PLEASURES FALL 2026 CollectionLos Angeles-based streetwear imprint PLEASURES explores the tension between the familiar and the unknown in its Fall 2026 collection, aptly titled "Somewhere In Between." The seasonal delivery blends subcultural nostalgia with contemporary, relaxed fits, focusing heavily on versatile layering for the transitional weather. The comprehensive wardrobe highlights textured outerwear, tactile knitwear, relaxed denim, and the brand's signature bold graphic apparel. The PLEASURES "Somewhere In Between" Fall 2026 collection is available to shop now directly through the brand'sofficial website and select global stockists.C2H4® 012 Collection Fall DeliveryLos Angeles and Shanghai-based menswear label C2H4® expands its continuous, year-round 012 Collection with a new fall delivery that translates mid-century interior design into contemporary fashion. Drawing aesthetic cues from 1950s and 1960s architecture, the collection balances retro nostalgia with modern urban utility across refined, durable silhouettes designed to age naturally with the wearer. Standout garments include the Mechanic Washed Engineer Jacket, Moccasin Memory Textured Henley, and the Lake Tahoe Cabin Gentle Padded Vest. With prices ranging from $90 to $1,450 USD, the C2H4® 012 Collection fall delivery is available to purchase now via the brand's global webstore.Bear Walker x ONE PIECE Devil Fruit Blindbox Skate DeckSkateboarding artist Bear Walker has teamed up with the legendary anime franchise ONE PIECE for an exclusive Devil Fruit Blindbox Skate Deck collection. Merging high-end craftsmanship with pop culture, the custom-carved wooden decks feature holographic finishes and highlight key characters like Luffy, Chopper, and Blackbeard alongside their respective Devil Fruits. The mystery blind box packaging adds a thrilling element of surprise for collectors, with ultra-rare 1-of-1 chase boards hidden throughout the release. Priced at $110 USD each, the Bear Walker x ONE PIECE Devil Fruit collection officially drops on August 21 via Bear Walker's webstore and Pensacola flagship location.

title: 「ユニクロ」の歴史が分かるタグ変遷と見分け方
summary: 誰もが知るあのブランドの歴史を「タグ」の変遷で紐解く連載。今回取り上げるのは、日本を代表するカジュアルウェアブランド「ユニクロ（UNIQLO）」です。 　特に、創業から2000年代前半までのアイテムは「オールドユニクロ」として、古着市場で少しずつ注目を集めています。ただし、ユニクロのタグは時代ごとに名称も年代も情報が入り乱れており、正確とはいえない情報も少なくありません。 　今回はオールドユニクロを収集し、当時のチラシやカタログ、ファーストリテイリングの有価証券報告書などの一次資料からブランドの「商品史」を独自に研究してきたミフラさんに、各年代のタグの特徴を見分け方を伺いました。 ミフラ （mihra） オールドユニクロ研究家 オールドユニクロの収集家・研究家。セカンドストリートで偶然古いタグのユニクロを見つけたことがきっかけに、オールドユニクロにのめり込む。現在は、リサイクルショップなどで昔のユニクロを探して購入することを趣味のひとつとしている。ネット上に体系的な資料が少ないことから一次資料を集め、年代ごとのタグや商品の変遷を独自に調査・発信している。 このコンテンツは FASHIONSNAP が配信しています。

title: MAAP and Public Possession Team up for Volume II Cycling and Lifestyle Collection
summary:
Summary

MAAP and Public Possession have reunited for Volume II of their collaborative cycling and lifestyle apparel collectionThe capsule spans technical on-bike performance wear alongside off-bike garments graphic tees and accessoriesThe full assortment is available now online and through select global retail locations

MAAP and Public Possession have officially launched their second collaborative collection, dubbed Volume II. Bringing together the Australian cycling outfit and the Munich-based music and clothing label, the release bridges cycling performance, sound, and subculture across a full selection of on- and off-bike apparel.The comprehensive collection explores the intersection of cycling subculture, travel, and music heritage. For on-bike performance, the technical lineup features MAAP’s ProAir 3.0 and Emerge Jerseys, Team Bib Evo Cargo Bibs, and Long Sleeve Mesh Tees. Meanwhile, the off-bike offerings introduce casual sportswear options including short- and long-sleeve graphic tees, crewnecks, hoodies, and rain pants. One graphic tee notably plays with visual perception, incorporating an intentional typo design reading "I Want To To Ride My Bicycle."Rounding out the capsule is an array of functional accessories designed for both riding and daily use, including cycling caps, musettes, socks, water bottles, and an oversized tote bag. To celebrate the launch and showcase their shared love of sound, the duo also released an exclusive collaborative mix hosted on Soundcloud.The MAAP x Public Possession Volume II collection drops August 18, 2026, available now via MAAP, Public Possession, the Public Possession Munich store, and global MAAP LaB retail locations.

title: Pas Normal Studios Elevates Off-Bike Lifestyle With FW26 Off-Race Collection
summary:
Summary

Pas Normal Studios has officially announced its Autumn/Winter 2026 Off-Race collection engineered for off-bike routinesThe comprehensive modular line features technical down liners boiled wool jackets and tech corduroy pantsCycling-derived details like rear zippered storage and two-way zippers are integrated into everyday lifestyle garments

Pas Normal Studios has officially debuted its Fall/Winter 2026 Off-Race Collection, expanding its technical cycling DNA into a full off-bike wardrobe. Originating in Copenhagen, the seasonal offering translates cycling precision, functional detailing, and minimalist Scandinavian aesthetics into everyday lifestyle apparel built for shifting weather conditions.Engineered as a complete modular layering system, the FW26 collection is anchored by several new outerwear and apparel silhouettes. Key pieces include the Off-Race Down Liner Jacket, the Women’s Off-Race Boiled Wool Jacket, and the Off-Race Tech Corduroy Pants. These core additions are supported by new merino knitwear, boiled wool styles, and breathable Japanese seersucker garments. Functional elements derived directly from riding kit appear throughout, including jersey-inspired rear zippered pockets for essential storage, reflective branding, and two-way front zippers for temperature regulation.The material selection balances technical protection with natural comfort, incorporating responsibly sourced down, naturally insulating wool, and durable technical corduroy. Grounding the collection, the color palette combines foundational tones of Black, Steel, Dark Coffee, and Dark Navy with earthy shades of Dusty Earth, Deep Olive, Wood, and Sandstone, alongside contrast accents of Dark Lime and Ochre.The Pas Normal Studios FW26 Off-Race Collection is now available online.

Summary

The collection features a range of premium lifestyle garments, including hoodies, athletic jerseys, graphic T-shirts, and long-sleeve shirts. One of the pieces gives a nod to Hasbulla Magomedov while Drake and OVO also pay homage to Islam Makhachev who recently defeated Ian Machado Garry and now holds the record for the longest individual winning streak in UFC history at 17 consecutive wins.Fronting the release campaign is No. 12-ranked UFC welterweight contender Mike Malott.
